Izzy Nguyen: Dropping an exploratory iteration for the latency dashboard — Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/latency-vertical-histogram Summary: - Replace wide heatmap with a vertical histogram lane when horizontal space is constrained so we can keep the p95 headline and the timepicker on a single row. - Sampling control becomes a compact inline chip labelled 'Sampling' (Off / 10% / 25% / 100% / Custom). Clicking 'Custom' opens a small modal with a slider. - Show a tiny 'Sampled' chip next to the metric when sampling != Off. Chip shows percent (e.g., 'Sampled • 10%') and opens a persistent help region for screen readers. - Add a dashed vertical marker for the p95 across both histogram and sparkline views; if p95 is from sampled data add an asterisk and note '*estimated from sample' inside help region. - Keyboard shortcut proposal: 'Shift+S' focus sampling chip; Left/Right to nudge, Enter to open Custom. Looking for quick feedback on discoverability of Sampling, chip wording, and the estimated marker UX. Evan Moore: Nice idea — vertical lane could reduce horizontal scrolling when side panels are open. A couple notes: - Chip wording: "Sampled • 10%" is clear. Keep the dot separator. - We should show exact percent in the DOM (not just visually) so users can copy it for bug reports. - For tiny viewports hide the histogram and surface only the sparkline + p95 marker. Priya Singh: Accessibility thoughts: - Sampling chip must be a real button with aria-expanded when the modal is open and aria-haspopup=\"dialog\" for the Custom modal. - Persistent help region: render a visible text node like
...text...
and link chip aria-describedby to it. Don’t rely on hover. - Provide aria-valuetext on the slider in the Custom modal (e.g., "Sampling rate 10 percent"). Alec Park: Product/telemetry: - Record sampling_percent and sampling_mode (off|preset|custom) in query metadata so we can reproduce views during investigations. - If sampling <5% consider showing a low-confidence warning inside the help region and optionally color the chip orange. - When users toggle Sampling globally vs per-panel we need a clear banner indicating scope. accessibility-bot: Checklist added to ticket INFR-5010: - [ ] Sampling chip implements button role + aria-describedby to persistent help region - [ ] Custom modal slider exposes aria-valuetext and aria-valuenow - [ ] p95 marker has descriptive text when estimated from sample - [ ] Low-confidence state described in help region when percent <5% - [ ] DOM contains explicit sampling_percent text near the chip Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-5010 design-bot: UX notes added to ticket INFR-5010: - [ ] Chip copy: 'Sampled • X%' (copyable text node) - [ ] Keyboard shortcut 'Shift+S' prototype and telemetry - [ ] Small-screen fallback: show sparkline + p95 marker only - [ ] Modal for Custom sampling reproduces slider with numeric input Izzy Nguyen: Thanks everyone — I'll update the Figma with the persistent help region text and add the low-confidence orange state. Scheduling a short playtest Fri 11am PT to validate keyboard flow and the Custom modal. Inviting @Priya Singh @Evan Moore @Alec Park. Evan Moore: I'll join and bring a quick mobile width checklist. Priya Singh: I'll run an a11y pass during playtest and report any screen reader surprises. Alec Park: I'll coordinate with infra to ensure sampling_percent lands in query logs for staging. Izzy Nguyen: Great — will post playtest notes and an updated ticket after the session. :sparkles:
